answer: CXCL12–ACKR3 ligand–receptor pair; CXCL12 is expressed by pre-Dc cells and ACKR3 is on epidermal basal cells
support_quote: Receptor–ligand analysis predicted interactions between CXCL12 expressed by pre-Dc cells (Extended Data Fig. 4g,h) with ACKR3 on epidermal basal cells (Fig. 2g and Supplementary Table 8). This result suggests that CXCL12 probably interacts with ACKR3 to mediate the migration of pre-Dc cells
